expo.name: Cab Service
expo.//scheme: Registers cabservice:// on the phone. App.js declares that as its deep-link prefix, so without this every in-app link was dead on iOS/Android.

ios.//bundleIdentifier: Required to build for iOS at all — change the reverse-domain part to your own domain before submitting.

android.//package: Required to build for Android at all.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: This app uses your location to share the cab's live position with employees.
